description: r.fin has an async finalizer that waits on a Notify nobody signals. t.a ends and the driver finishes r.fin at 100: its tasks are done, so it reaches Finalizing and the lab spawns f.hold, which parks. A region with a finalizer left is not quiescent (state.rs:7408, finalizers_empty) and cannot reach Closed: the run ends with r.fin Finalizing, f.hold live and snapshot.quiescent false. t.k in r.other keeps the lab stepping to 300.
